frame_envelope.reason_for_64px_width: Preserve body scale and lead-fist extension without clipping or shrinking the approved character.

pose_roster.pose: lead shoulder loads slightly back; chin tucked; both guards high; feet fixed
lead elbow clears torso; shoulder starts rotation; rear hand protects jaw
lead fist reaches horizontal endpoint; shoulder guards chin; eyes and jaw show effort
fist retracts; hair and sash complete one delayed beat; base stays grounded
guard reconnects to idle without snapping; torso and secondary motion settle

motion_physics_contract.center_of_mass: maximum one-pixel forward translation at native scale; no root-foot slide
motion_physics_contract.lead_arm_arc: direct shoulder-to-target line; elbow never disconnects or crosses behind torso
motion_physics_contract.rear_guard: stays between jaw and opponent for every frame
motion_physics_contract.foot_contact: both feet remain on ground_y=60; minimal rear-heel lift may be internal cluster change only
motion_physics_contract.mass_conservation: head, torso, hips and leg volumes may rotate but cannot change scale

forbidden: direct high-resolution downscale as final art
horizontal compression of the whole body to retain a 48px cell
baked hit spark or water FX

direct promotion to data/processed or res before native key-pose approval
